_readme: Business details used on every page. Leave a value empty ("") and the site shows a yellow [PLACEHOLDER] until you fill it in. See README.md.
_launchMode: true once the site is public: blank optional details (licensed line, email, response time, project towns) are left out instead of showing a yellow [PLACEHOLDER]. Set false while building.
name: TVIS Construction
_address: the address exactly as the Google Business Profile shows it (Google checks that the site and the profile match). Leave streetAddress empty if the profile hides the address (service-area business): the site then shows the city only.
_geo: the profile's map pin (plus code 4QV6+4C Hixson)
serviceTowns: Chattanooga, Downtown, St. Elmo, Red Bank, Signal Mountain, Hixson, Soddy-Daisy, Highway 58, Brainerd, East Brainerd, East Ridge, Ooltewah, Cleveland, Jasper, Sequatchie County and North Georgia
_googleBusinessProfile: the profile's Maps link: Google Business Profile > Share > Copy link (https://maps.app.goo.gl/...). Turns the Google marks into links and joins the schema sameAs and hasMap.
_googleReviewUrl: the review link: Google Business Profile > Ask for reviews > Copy link (https://g.page/r/.../review). Shows a 'Leave us a Google review' link in the footer.
_googleSiteVerification: the code from Google Search Console > Settings > Ownership verification > HTML tag (just the content value). Leave empty if you verify through DNS instead.
